fieldOverrides.//: A SECOND DEVICE does not know its own local id yet, so it cannot address its identity document at users/{localId}/profile/self - it has to find it by COLLECTION GROUP. A single-field index is automatic for a collection but NOT for a collection group, and it is configured HERE rather than under "indexes": Firestore rejects a one-field entry there with 'this index is not necessary, configure using single field index controls'. The array-contains clause in the query is not optional either - rules REJECT a query they cannot prove rather than filtering it, and the read rule tests visibleTo. See services/firebase/firebaseProfile.ts.
